newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-TOUR CHANGES ROUTE TO AVOID DEMONSTRATION.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-TOUR CHANGES ROUTE TO AVOID DEMONSTRATION.

text.p: The route of the sixth stage of the Tour de France between Le Blanc and Marennes was changed for 10 km to avoid a demonstration against a nuclear waste storage project.
Riders were told to take a diversion after 77.5 km and returned to the scheduled route after 86.5 km in the 217-km stage.
The detour made the stage longer by five kms, organisers said.
A small group of demonstrators was blocking the road with tractors.
